newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes higher, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes higher, volume down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly higher on Wednesday but trade volume was lower, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index rose to 498.84 from 496.76 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 750,972 dinars against 5.14 million dinars.
Coke and beer bottler SFBT gained one dinar to 87.2 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia rose 0.6 dinar to 45. Airliner Tunis Air advanced 0.49 dinar to 19.89.
BTEI bank advanced 0.18 dinar to 23. Banque de Tunisie was up 0.1 dinar to 74.1.
